The maximum likelihood tree for COI (Fig. 4) clusters our Omanian specimen (bootstrap support 94 %, Bayesian probability 0.99) within R. rufescens, all the other specimens of this species are from Nepal, Bangladesh, and Myanmar. The p-distance within this group was 0.017. The Omanian specimen differed from the other R. rufescens by p-distance 0.007 – 0.036.
